{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Midweight wool-blend blazer, structured lapel cut, knee-length silhouette, charcoal grey (#36454F), woven tweed fabric with a subtle herringbone pattern.
Slim-fit cotton poplin blouse, tailored yoke and button-down front, hip-length hem, crisp white (#FFFFFF), smooth sateen weave.
Tailored wool trousers, straight-leg cut with a slight break at the shoe, full-length drape, forest green (#2E4C39), heavy gabardine fabric with natural crease retention.
Leather loafers, penny-cap design with minimal branding, ankle height coverage, matte black (#000000), supressed calfskin leather.
Thin silk scarf, rectangular cut with fringed edges, loosely draped length around the neck, rust orange (#E07A5F), 100% mulberry silk.

This outfit works because it strikes the perfect balance between professional polish and autumnal warmth without appearing too heavy for an office setting. The textured tweed blazer adds visual interest against the crisp white blouse and solid-colored trousers, creating a sophisticated monochromatic harmony that reads as "smart" rather than overly formal. While the weather is cool enough to warrant a jacket, the choice of natural fibers like wool and silk ensures comfort and breathability throughout the day. Completing the look with classic loafers grounds the ensemble in timeless style while allowing for easy movement between meetings and casual moments."}
